title: Apple working on ‘Netflix for games,’ report says
text: Apple working on ‘Netflix for games,’ report says Monday, 28 January 2019 ( 2 hours ago ) Apple Inc. is exploring the idea of launching a subscription service for games. The platform would work like a ‘Netflix for games,’ charging a flat fee for access to a library of titles. Cheddar first reported the news, citing five anonymous sources. The move would come as Apple (Nasdaq: AAPL) is facing declining hardware sales. The computer giant revised its first-quarter guidance at the start of the year to reflect $5 billion less revenue due to slower-than-expected holiday iPhone sales. A… ▶ Apple May Offer Video Game Streaming Service In The Future 00:40 Apple is planning a subscription service for games, according to five people familiar with the matter. The service would function like Netflix for games, allowing users who pay a subscription fee to access a bundled list of titles.
